Hello and welcome to another exciting installment of Tales of Terra-Nova I am your humble dungeon master and you are my intrepid heroes, say hi intrepid heroes! In our previous session we had the Champions Convergence, Augustus was chosen to lead the champions, Magnus gave us a map of Arkonia, and Igan sent us 3 airships to use in our battle. (How nice) We talked to a bunch of NPCs, Tyran returned, and Damion joined our merry band of devout warriors!

Ivys went through some sudden and painful realizations through his dreams and visions, and we traveled to the town of Archemos to enjoy the festival! Now we return to the town as we sit in the pub enjoying our afternoon lunch together. 
As we eat and talk about our last exciting session, a young boy (Isaac) from the village walks up to your table and asks if you're here to celebrate the eclipse with them?

Isaac says you all look strong and talented, and should participate in the contests this afternoon! He says there is a music competition and an an athletic competition.
